name: Personal Library Manager
overview: Beta 1: personal lists, favorites and Watch Later. Linux x64 only.
description: Create private personal collections from your Jellyfin catalog. Integrates native favorites, Watch Later, private list thumbnails, search, genres, pagination and recoverable deletion without deleting original media. First beta: tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0 and Linux x64 only; other hosts and architectures are not validated. The web interface requires Plugin Pages 3.0.3.0 and File Transformation 3.0.3.0, Release-12.4.0 builds. Back up your configuration and PLM data before installing. Interface translations are partial outside English/Portuguese, with English fallback. Optional native playlist mirrors remain experimental.

versions.changelog: First public beta. Private lists, native favorites, Watch Later, private thumbnails, recoverable deletion, filters, pagination, theme-aware controls and interface-language preferences. Linux x64; tested on Jellyfin 12.4.0. Requires Plugin Pages and File Transformation 3.0.3.0 Release-12.4.0. Partial translations outside English/Portuguese; English fallback. Back up before installing.
